name: hound-grounded
description: Control run for the houndframe trial (?hound=1): sprint the low floor route into the first hound's plate (x=39..47) and stay on the deck. The only jump is the one the terrain demands — the +1 step at x=39 — and the houndframe's telegraph is ignored. Pairs with hound-jump.json, which is byte-identical apart from one extra jump on the tell, so the damage difference between the two runs is caused by the charge and nothing else. Neither script fires: this is evidence about movement, not about killing the enemy.
